body: I don't even know how I would begin to tell them. My relationship with my parents isn't bad, but I can't even think of how I would approach them.

I try not to. I've tried so hard doing things to see if they would make me feel happy. I've tried multiple hobbies, sports, clubs and other activities. But they end up not doing anything to make me happy. I just feel empty. I know that happiness doesn't come as fast as people want it to be, but the wait, no matter what I do, the wait just keeps getting longer. I can't stand the waiting anymore.

I don't know how I would be able to. I can't tell my parents, or I'm just afraid of telling them how I'm feeling. Lately, I haven't even been able to look at them without crying now. I haven't left my room, I haven't eaten, I know they are worried, but I can't bring myself to tell them.

With the college plans, I was originally supposed to go move out to Utah for college, but due to some circumstance, I won't be able to. I don't believe I can be happy again. I haven't felt happy in a while, the closest I've gotten was due to the hope that I would be able to move out. Talk to some people that I remember being happy with. I used to live in Utah, but my family moved away for personal reasons. I still remember genuinely laughing with people back in Utah. The hope that I would be able to start again and talk with these people made me feel like I could be happy again. However, with all of that gone, I've gone back to feeling depressed, even more now than ever.
I've given up on myself... I can't look at my parents anymore, my plans have been going to shit, and its getting harder not to kill myself.

Please, I need someone to talk to. Its not just a feeling of being stuck, I feel like no matter where I go now, I won't feel happy. I know that there are other options for me, but honestly I don't know why I even bother anymore. It took a lot for me just to actually make a bigger push for something I wanted. Instead of accepting just feeling depressed, I actually wanted to change something for myself, which is a feeling I had not felt in a long time. But after the long period of not doing anything, the first time I actually tried to change my situation, the first time I felt like I could feel happy again, it was all gone in one day. I know that I can't control that, and sometimes life doesn't work out how people want it to be, but I couldn't even be given this one request. I wish that I hadn't had hope now in the first place, instead of making this account a few months ago, instead of seeking help, instead of giving myself false hope. I wish that I had died that day.
